t.E576.agn: In 1998 JECFA set a group ADI 'not specified' for glucono delta-lactone and the calcium, magnesium, potassium and sodium salts of gluconic acid. JECFA reported that single doses of glucono delta-lactone above 20 g have a laxative effect in humans and that diarrhoea has been reported in volunteers taking 20–50 g per day. EFSA's re-evaluation in the EU is ongoing (a new call for data was issued in 2023).
t.E576.body: Gluconic acid and its salts are normal intermediates formed in the body during the breakdown of glucose via the pentose phosphate pathway; part of the ingested gluconate is excreted unchanged in urine and the rest is broken down.
t.E576.found.0: In the EU, may be used in many foods at quantum satis (as much as needed)
t.E576.prod: Produced by fermentation or by chemical catalytic oxidation.
t.E576.pw.0: A source of sodium. Sodium from additives is usually less than that from salt.
t.E576.regx.0: Group ADI 'not specified' for glucono delta-lactone and gluconate salts.
t.E576.regx.1: Group I additive; generally authorised at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E576.regx.2: Re-evaluation ongoing; a call for data was issued in 2023 (deadline 31.03.2024).
t.E576.summary: The sodium salt of gluconic acid. Used as a sequestrant and acidity regulator.
t.E576.what: The sodium salt of gluconic acid, used as an acidity regulator and metal-binding agent (sequestrant).
